intro: Explore Fuerteventura, from the golden dunes of Corralejo and the beaches of Costa Calma to the old streets of Betancuria and the dramatic coastline at Ajuy. Save your holiday plans, favourite visits, photos and spending on your device.

areas.name: Corralejo
areas.description: Lively northern resort with beaches, restaurants, boat excursions and nearby dunes.

areas.name: Caleta de Fuste
areas.description: Family-friendly east coast resort with sheltered beaches and a marina.

areas.name: Costa Calma
areas.description: Relaxed southern resort known for broad sandy beaches.

areas.name: Morro Jable & Jandía
areas.description: Southern resort area with a long beach, promenade and harbour.

areas.name: El Cotillo
areas.description: Northwest fishing village with lagoons, surf beaches and sunsets.

areas.name: Puerto del Rosario
areas.description: Island capital with shops, waterfront and local cultural attractions.

areas.name: Betancuria
areas.description: Historic inland village with traditional Canarian architecture.

attractions.name: Parque Natural de Corralejo
attractions.description: Protected dune landscape and sweeping sandy coastline; follow designated access routes.

attractions.name: Isla de Lobos
attractions.description: Protected small island reached by boat from Corralejo; check permits and sailing conditions.

attractions.name: Cuevas de Ajuy
attractions.description: Sea caves reached by a coastal walking path; stay clear of cliff edges and rough seas.

attractions.name: Betancuria historic centre
attractions.description: Explore the historic village, church surroundings and mountain scenery.

attractions.name: Mirador de Morro Velosa
attractions.description: Mountain viewpoint; check whether facilities are open before travelling.

attractions.name: Oasis Wildlife Fuerteventura
attractions.description: Wildlife and botanical attraction near La Lajita; check current tickets and animal welfare information.

transport.name: Walking
transport.description: Coastal promenades are pleasant, but exposed beaches and inland paths can be windy and hot.

transport.name: TiADHE buses
transport.description: Island bus services connect major towns and resorts; check current routes and timetables.

transport.name: Car hire
transport.description: Useful for quieter beaches and inland villages; some remote roads are unpaved.

transport.name: Taxis
transport.description: Licensed taxis are available in main resort areas; check the fare or meter.

transport.name: Airport connections
transport.description: Fuerteventura Airport (FUE) has bus, taxi and hire-car options; confirm current services.

transport.name: Ferries
transport.description: Ferries connect Corralejo with Lanzarote and Morro Jable with Gran Canaria; check schedules.

useful.name: Emergency services
useful.description: Call 112 in an emergency in Spain.

useful.name: Wind and sun
useful.description: Fuerteventura is often windy; use sun protection, water and secure loose belongings.

useful.name: Sea safety
useful.description: Follow beach flags and lifeguard instructions; surf and currents can be powerful.

useful.name: Currency
useful.description: Euro (€); check bank fees and exchange rates.

useful.name: Travel documents
useful.description: Check UK government travel advice for Spain and your travel insurance.

useful.name: Language
useful.description: Spanish is the official language; English is commonly spoken in tourist resorts.

useful.name: Nature protection
useful.description: Respect dune paths, wildlife and protected coastal areas; take litter away.

beaches.name: Grandes Playas de Corralejo
beaches.description: Long sandy beaches beside the dunes; exposed to wind and waves.

beaches.name: Playa de Sotavento
beaches.description: Expansive southeast beach famous for changing tidal lagoons and watersports.

beaches.name: Playa de Cofete
beaches.description: Remote wild beach with dramatic mountains; dangerous currents and difficult road access.

beaches.name: Playa del Castillo
beaches.description: Sheltered beach at Caleta de Fuste, popular with families.

beaches.name: Playa de la Concha, El Cotillo
beaches.description: Sandy cove with clear water; always check conditions.

beaches.name: Playa del Matorral
beaches.description: Long sandy beach near Morro Jable and its lighthouse.

markets.name: Corralejo shopping streets
markets.description: Browse shops and local businesses; check market schedules locally.

markets.name: Caleta de Fuste markets
markets.description: Resort markets may operate on selected days; confirm locally.

markets.name: Puerto del Rosario
markets.description: Explore town-centre shopping and local shops.

markets.name: Morro Jable
markets.description: Resort shops and occasional markets; check dates and opening times.

nightlife.name: Corralejo evenings
nightlife.description: Bars, live music and restaurants around the resort centre.

nightlife.name: Caleta de Fuste
nightlife.description: Relaxed pubs and family-friendly evening venues.

nightlife.name: El Cotillo sunset
nightlife.description: Enjoy a quieter evening overlooking the west coast.

family.name: Caleta de Fuste beach day
family.description: A sheltered resort beach with facilities nearby.

family.name: Corralejo dunes
family.description: Scenic beach visit; avoid fragile dune areas and pack sun protection.

family.name: Glass-bottom or boat excursion
family.description: Check local operators, weather and age suitability.

family.name: Oasis Wildlife Fuerteventura
family.description: Animal and botanical park; review facilities and animal welfare details.

family.name: Family photo trail
family.description: Collect favourite holiday photos and save them in your Photo Album.

dining.name: Corralejo harbour area
dining.description: Find seafood restaurants, cafés and casual dining.

dining.name: El Cotillo
dining.description: Try local fish restaurants and sunset dining.

dining.name: Caleta de Fuste
dining.description: Resort restaurants with varied international menus.

dining.name: Betancuria
dining.description: Look for traditional Canarian dishes in the historic village.

daytrips.name: Betancuria and mountain viewpoints
daytrips.description: Explore the island interior, scenic roads and historic architecture.

daytrips.name: El Cotillo and northwest coast
daytrips.description: Discover lagoons, coastal scenery and a relaxed fishing village.

daytrips.name: Isla de Lobos
daytrips.description: Boat excursion from Corralejo; permits may be required.

daytrips.name: Ajuy caves and village
daytrips.description: Coastal caves, dramatic cliffs and a small fishing village.

daytrips.name: Cofete viewpoint
daytrips.description: Remote mountain scenery; road conditions and access can be challenging.

daytrips.name: Lanzarote by ferry
daytrips.description: Day trip from Corralejo to Playa Blanca; check sailing times and return arrangements.
